text: Arrow/path tail = the previous drawable primitive (card|pill|stack|bracket) in list order; toDiagram emits the edge from that primitive's head node (stack: last fan node).
coverage(scene, show?) resolves show from the argument, else the scene object, else a structural clone (same primitives JSON); an unknown scene fails loudly with unmatched ['(show unknown)'].
Breather keeps the primitives that preserve show-coverage: chunk nouns into <= 2 marks with joined labels; never drop a term to get under the cap.
'X between A and B' draws an arrow A->B; the referents land first and the newcomer X lands last, on the edge (direction encodes relation).
G38 strict: every terms(show) term is matched by a non-edge mark (card|pill|stack|counter label or from); an arrow's from-span never counts as a noun's mark.
G38 literal: an unquoted '<count> <plural>' in show draws >= count marks (stack counts n).
sed 's/if (f0) join(f0, d, null);/if (f0) P.splice(P.indexOf(d), 1);/' (drop a same-noun duplicate instead of merging its span) must fail G38 on mcp#0 (unmatched 'locked').
Actor lands first; the last-landing noun (the hotspot) is the object of the film line (adapter/drawer/sign), never the character.
Noun continuity: a noun key (normalised head noun; robot|character = actor) owns one slot across a board's beats; callback stacks fan one step off their noun's slot.
